claim_boundary: Author-run, outcome-visible, non-independent retrospective methodological audit. The analysis does not create external validation, restore blindness, or establish biological discovery.
relevance: Binary later-recorded strict A/B endpoint relation within each frozen scope.
tie_definition: Exact equality of the serialized finite floating-point score after round-trip parsing; legacy salted ranks are never used to define a tie block.

tie_model.recall_expected: For a tie block of m items containing r relevant items and contributing s top-k positions, expected relevant count is r*s/m.
tie_model.recall_lower: For that block, max(0, r-(m-s)) relevant items enter top-k.
tie_model.recall_upper: For that block, min(r,s) relevant items enter top-k.
tie_model.ndcg_expected: Each evaluated position in a tie block has relevance probability r/m; expected DCG uses the standard binary discount 1/log2(rank+1).
tie_model.ndcg_lower: Place the forced relevant items at the least-discounted evaluated positions of every tie block.
tie_model.ndcg_upper: Place as many relevant items as possible at the most-discounted evaluated positions of every tie block.
tie_model.normalizer: IDCG@k for the observed number of relevant targets for that query and scope.
tie_model.query_any_hit_probability: Exact hypergeometric probability of at least one relevant top-k member under the uniform boundary-tie allocation.
tie_model.score_identifiable_rule: A query metric is score-identifiable only when its attainable lower and upper bounds are equal within absolute tolerance 1e-15; otherwise it is tie-dependent.
tie_model.multi_salt_repetition: not_run; theoretical uniform-tie expectation and exact attainable bounds are primary

query_subsets.all_queries: All evaluable queries in the scope.
query_subsets.score_operational: For sequence_3mer_transfer only, at least one eligible candidate has score strictly greater than zero.
query_subsets.structural_all_zero: For sequence_3mer_transfer only, every eligible candidate has score exactly zero; reported as non-operational tie allocation, not algorithmic ranking performance.

uncertainty.query_bootstrap_estimand: Equally query-weighted macro mean of the within-tie expected query metric for a query drawn from the empirical scope/subset distribution; query units are resampled independently with replacement.
uncertainty.pmid_component_estimand: The same equally query-weighted macro mean, with uncertainty perturbed by resampling scope/subset-specific connected components of the undirected query-PMID bipartite graph; sampled components contribute all member queries and the replicate is normalized by the sampled query count.
uncertainty.interpretation_difference: The query bootstrap describes query-to-query sampling variability under an independence approximation. The PMID-component bootstrap is a source-document dependence sensitivity and neither creates a document-disjoint test set nor changes the point estimand.

finite_sample_zero_hit_bound.event: A query has at least one later-recorded relevant target in the legacy fixed-salt top-50.
finite_sample_zero_hit_bound.method: One-sided exact Clopper-Pearson 95% upper confidence bound for a binomial proportion.
finite_sample_zero_hit_bound.assumption_boundary: Descriptive finite-sample bound under exchangeable independent Bernoulli queries; source-document dependence is not absorbed by this bound and is reported separately.
